_comments: Polymorphic foreign key declaration(s) on MJ_BizApps_Forms: Form Entity Binding Records: each payload field sets EntityIDFieldName to its companion EntityID discriminator field.
The primaryKey lookup is what makes this an UPDATE of the CodeGen-owned TargetRecordID row.
Without it MetadataSync treats a related record as a create (#319, v0.16 seed generation):
the push emitted spCreateEntityField with no Name and a NULL EntityID and failed the run,
and on MJ_ATS_Dev the field was never written at all. Same shape as .entities.json.
